# Lore

_Generated from `content/rules/lore.json`, `content/archetypes`._

> The Wyrm came, and stole our essence. In time, humans, beasts and skyfolk alike were born without faces. We became a new race: the Empty.

> Our only salvation became the cursed fossils we once tried to destroy: Relics, each carrying the soul of a fallen Hunter of old.

> Malgrave, the queen who ruled Solmere and never aged, was the Wyrm in human shape. The night a thief reached its heart, it woke and broke the land.

Factions are lore only (voice lines, banter, key art): a squad in a match stays free-pick.

### Factions

| Faction | Hunters | What binds them | What they would wish for |
|---|---|---|---|
| The Odd Jobs | Vex, Sparkle, Tenzo | The young, scrappy ones who grew up with nothing in the ruins after the Hollowing and look out for each other. Vex is the first Relic players meet, so this is the first crew they meet. | A world where nobody has to scrape by. |
| The Fallen Court | Kael, Cinder, Lace | Malgrave's arena champion, her court alchemist and her seamstress. They knew her best and know what she really is, which makes them the most dangerous crew. They don't trust each other. | Each wants something different: Kael freedom from the demon, Cinder the throne, Lace the last loyalist dead. |
| The Hearthguard | Albert, Neve, Meeko | The ones who saved people the night everything broke. | To heal the world. |
| Moth & Hook | Sable, Grimble | A duo in it for the treasure. | Malgrave's vault, all of it. |
| The Void Jester | Motley | He belongs to no one and plays every side against the others. | Nobody knows. The joke, probably. |

### Relics

Each fallen Hunter's self is held in the object they were most bound to. Wearing it gives you their face, form and memories. A relic marked proposed is still waiting for the owner's OK.

| Hunter | Relic | Why this one | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vex, the Hired Gun | Her first coin | The first coin she was ever paid. She flips it to pick her jobs. | locked |
| Kael, the Unbroken | His broken chain | The shackle he tore out of the arena wall, bound to the demon blade. | locked |
| Cinder, the Ashen Kiss | The empty vial of Wyrm's blood | She drank what she was told to distil. An ember still glows at the bottom of the vial. | proposed |
| Meeko, the Dawnfox | A glass globe of sun and rain | It holds her little sun and her raincloud. The shelter's last fire, kept alive all night. | proposed |
| Tenzo, the Stone Seer | A seeing-stone | One of the three stones that float around him. It is how he sees the world. | locked |
| Lace, the Red Stitch | The stitched porcelain face | She sewed it from scraps of the Relics she once made. | locked |
| Grimble, the Scrap King | His brass monocle | He priced every treasure in Malgrave's vault through it. | proposed |
| Neve, the Snowglide | Her ice skates | The night she skated the festival crowd to safety. | locked |
| Sparkle, the Storm Chaser | The lightning rod | From the top of the spire where Rink, the boy she loved, fell. The storm struck them both there. | locked |
| Albert, the Barnacle Knight | The ship's compass | Set in his chest now. It led his refugees home across the ice. | locked |
| Sable, the Silver Thief | Her moth-wing knife | In her hand when she touched the Wyrmheart. | locked |
| Motley, the Void Jester | His jack-in-the-box | Malgrave sealed him in it and threw it into the Void. | locked |

### Banter pairs

- Kael and Cinder: the Blight she distilled burned the cracks into his arm.
- Lace and anyone who served Malgrave.
- Everyone and Sable: she started the Hollowing.
- Vex and whoever didn't pay her.
- The Odd Jobs: Vex's loyalty is technically for sale, but she sticks with them. Tenzo is the calm one.
- Sable and Grimble: she opened the door, and he carries the loot out. Each thinks the other works for them.
